generalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in atleast two financial years an average annual financial turnover of rupees not less Rs. 45.93 lakhs (Profit and loss Account, Balance sheet certified, Audited by registered chartered Accountant are mandatory)
The Tender should have satisfactory completed one similar work to an extent of Rs.22.97 lakh
Assessed available tender capacity ( AxNx2.5 - B ) Should be greater than Rs. 45.93 Lakhs

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Form of tender is mandatory to be upload in kppp portal
Amount put to tender is exclusive of GST
Rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST
Profit & Loss Statement certified by Chartered accountant for a minimum period of Two Years upload in Kppp portal
Existing commitments/ on going Works upload in Kppp portal
Works for which tenders already submitted upload in Kppp portal
ITR for a Minimum period of Two financial years upload in Kppp portal
Qualification Information of clause 1.3(A) &(B) are mandatory
Contractor should have civil contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB etc
